method.what: Vial Instrumental's "SSO imitations" Long presets against CC1 (velocity = CC1, CC11 127) at the pitches SSO's Long was swept at (sso_cc1_curves.json; the eight wind presets since 2026-10-28 every semitone, as sso_winds_cc1_semitone.json: their 3-semitone points again within 0.06 dB), by sso_cc1_sweep.py's events and analyze (no UACC switch); the wind presets are even over pitch (Theil-Sen deviation at CC1 64 rms 0.02-0.19 dB)
method.host: kthost (Linux), offline, 44.1 kHz stereo float, 512-frame blocks split at each event; the preset as its component state (MuseScore: a preset library)
method.cc11: cc11At64: rmsDb at CC11 64 less at 127, CC1 64, the middle pitch (20 log10 (64 / 127) = -5.95)
